newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev idles below 500 vs dlr on calm market.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev idles below 500 vs dlr on calm market.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev idled between 493-500 per dollar in light interbank volume at midday, in a narrower spread than 485-500 opening quotes and virtually unchanged from Thursday's close at 490-500, dealers said.
"The market is very calm and the lev trades stable as foreign currency supply matches demand in low volumes," one dealer said.
Traders said they did not expect any sharp movements in the exchange rate by the end of the day because there has not been much willingness to trade ahead of the long Christmas holidays.
The central bank (BNB) was seen bidding for dollars at 490 levs, but no deals between BNB and commercial banks were reported at that level, traders said. BNB officials were not available for comment.
Trade began late today as the market was seeking direction ahead of Christmas holidays, dealers said.
Markets will be closed in Bulgaria from Monday through Thursday for Christmas recess. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
